faqLeft.q: What engine does the Range Rover Velar D180 use?
faqLeft.a: The Velar D180 uses the Ingenium AJ200D — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel. This engine has been fitted to the Velar since its 2017 launch and continues in current production.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Range Rover Velar D180 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Velar D180?
faqLeft.a: The Velar D180 uses the Ingenium AJ200D across the entire L560 generation. Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm your exact spec before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild Ingenium AJ200D Velar D180 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides, injector seals, EGR and gaskets as standard on every AJ200D rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Velar D180 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Velar D180 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Velar D180 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Velar D180 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
